facts.value: A nondegree student is one who has not attended ASU as a degree-seeking student, has not earned a bachelor's degree, is not attending full time and is not currently applying to a degree program.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Nondegree students can enroll in eight credit hours for each fall, spring, and summer semester.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: The maximum limit of credit hours for nondegree students is 24 credit hours over the course of the academic year.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Nondegree students may apply up to 15 hours taken in nondegree status to a degree program if they choose to pursue an undergraduate degree in the future.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Nondegree students are not eligible for financial aid.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Nondegree students may not be eligible for academic advising.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: VA education benefits are often not applicable to nondegree-seeking students.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Exceptions to these guidelines may be made for specific programs or partners with approval from the provost’s office.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA
